scope: Direct native ArrowEffects.GetYOffset and Player/NoteField getter observations. These are native executable samples, not the embedded semantic host's timing-only GetYOffset.

provenance.primary_source_comparison: The relevant MMod denominator and Player update/draw operations match the pinned executable source. Source line offsets differ.

notes: Within each capture, note_beats and each speed sample's y_offsets use the same indices as top-level query_deltas. sample_clock is shared unchanged by every speed query in that capture.
XMod() and MMod() both return numbers when MMod is active: the native MaxScrollBPM override wins. The music-rate multiplication occurs inside the f32 denominator.
Actual sampled clocks and note-beat arguments are preserved. Cast both note and current beat to f32 before subtracting; requested deltas can round when note beats cross an f32 exponent boundary.

The M350/read60/rate1.5 sample at requested delta10 is 2519.83837890625 because native f32 subtraction produces 10.000000953674316. A fixed current beat2/note beat12 uses delta10 exactly and gives 2519.838134765625.
Native CMod controls also depend on captured sync/global offset preferences. MusicRate is changed for each query and restored without advancing the native clock.
Player Update writes mini-only NoteField zoom. Player draw writes mini*tilt zoom and tilt rotation, then restores NoteField Y only. Rotation therefore persists across the next update.
Hidden or hibernating Player prevents draw-time publication; hidden NoteField alone does not. Mini updates continue in those observed cases.
Initial observations bracket the first mini/tilt publication; the native gameplay-clock callback starts later than the first Player update. OnCommand already sees rotation from preroll draws.
Scene geometry remains in the retained full captures. This compact fixture records direct native Lua return values and actor getter state, not a raster result.

reproduction.probe_lua:
local cfg = ITGMANIA_HARNESS_CONFIG
local levels = {"ModsLevel_Preferred", "ModsLevel_Stage", "ModsLevel_Song", "ModsLevel_Current"}
local cases = {
  {name="initial-mini60-tilt-positive", mini=0.6, tilt=0.5, reverse=0},
  {name="mini60-tilt-negative", mini=0.6, tilt=-0.5, reverse=0},
  {name="mini60-tilt-negative-reverse", mini=0.6, tilt=-0.5, reverse=1},
  {name="hidden-player", mini=0.2, tilt=0.8, reverse=0, hide_player=true},
  {name="hidden-notefield", mini=0.2, tilt=0.8, reverse=0, hide_field=true},
  {name="hibernating-player", mini=0.4, tilt=-0.5, reverse=0, hibernate=0.5},
  {name="visible-baseline", mini=0, tilt=0, reverse=0},
}
local result = {schema=1, native_source=ITGMANIA_HARNESS_NATIVE_SOURCE,
  speed_samples={}, transforms={}, phases=cases}
local phase, update_recorded, draw_recorded = 0, 0, 0
local have_speed = false
local function actors()
  local screen = SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen()
  local player = screen and screen:GetChild("PlayerP1")
  return player, player and player:GetChild("NoteField")
end
local function clocks()
  local ps = GAMESTATE:GetPlayerState(PLAYER_1)
  local pp, gp = ps:GetSongPosition(), GAMESTATE:GetSongPosition()
  return {
    player_beat=pp:GetSongBeat(), player_visible_beat=pp:GetSongBeatVisible(),
    player_seconds=pp:GetMusicSeconds(), player_visible_seconds=pp:GetMusicSecondsVisible(),
    player_bps=pp:GetCurBPS(),
    game_beat=gp:GetSongBeat(), game_visible_beat=gp:GetSongBeatVisible(),
    game_seconds=gp:GetMusicSeconds(), game_visible_seconds=gp:GetMusicSecondsVisible(),
    game_bps=gp:GetCurBPS()
  }
end
local function pose(actor)
  if not actor then return {present=false} end
  return {present=true, name=actor:GetName(), visible=actor:GetVisible(),
    x=actor:GetX(), y=actor:GetY(), z=actor:GetZ(),
    zoom=actor:GetZoom(), zoom_x=actor:GetZoomX(), zoom_y=actor:GetZoomY(), zoom_z=actor:GetZoomZ(),
    rotation_x=actor:GetRotationX(), rotation_y=actor:GetRotationY(), rotation_z=actor:GetRotationZ()}
end
local function observe(label)
  local player, field = actors()
  local po = GAMESTATE:GetPlayerState(PLAYER_1):GetPlayerOptions("ModsLevel_Current")
  result.transforms[#result.transforms+1] = {
    point=label, case_index=phase, case_name=cases[phase] and cases[phase].name or "initial",
    native_update_sequence=ITGMANIA_HARNESS_NATIVE_UPDATE_SEQUENCE(), clocks=clocks(),
    mini=po:Mini(), tilt=po:Tilt(), skew=po:Skew(), reverse=po:Reverse(),
    player=pose(player), notefield=pose(field)
  }
end
local function publish()
  local file=RageFileUtil:CreateRageFile()
  assert(file:Open("/Save/itgmania-harness/multitap-native-probe.json",2))
  file:Write(JsonEncode(result))
  file:Close()
  file:destroy()
end
local function apply_case(index)
  local row=cases[index]
  phase=index
  for _,level in ipairs(levels) do
    local po=GAMESTATE:GetPlayerState(PLAYER_1):GetPlayerOptions(level)
    po:Mini(row.mini)
    po:Tilt(row.tilt)
    po:Skew(0)
    po:Reverse(row.reverse)
  end
  local player,field=actors()
  player:visible(not row.hide_player)
  player:hibernate(row.hibernate or 0)
  field:visible(not row.hide_field)
end
local function speed_samples()
  local ps=GAMESTATE:GetPlayerState(PLAYER_1)
  local po=ps:GetPlayerOptions("ModsLevel_Current")
  local so=GAMESTATE:GetSongOptionsObject("ModsLevel_Current")
  local original_rate=so:MusicRate()
  result.sample_clock=clocks()
  result.song_display_bpms=GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayBpms()
  result.steps_display_bpms=GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(PLAYER_1):GetDisplayBpms()
  result.timing_bpms=GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(PLAYER_1):GetTimingData():GetBPMs()
  local deltas={-5,-2,0,1,2,4,10}
  local function sample(label, rate, amount, wave, period)
    so:MusicRate(rate)
    po:Wave(wave or 0)
    po:WavePeriod(period or 0)
    if label=="MMod" then po:MMod(amount)
    elseif label=="XMod" then po:XMod(amount)
    elseif label=="CMod" then po:CMod(amount)
    else error("unknown mode") end
    local beat=ps:GetSongPosition():GetSongBeatVisible()
    local row={mode=label, rate=so:MusicRate(), amount=amount, wave=po:Wave(), wave_period=po:WavePeriod(),
      xmod=po:XMod(), cmod=po:CMod(), mmod=po:MMod(), scroll_speed=po:ScrollSpeed(),
      max_scroll_bpm=po:MaxScrollBPM(), time_spacing=po:TimeSpacing(), clock=clocks(), offsets={}}
    for _,delta in ipairs(deltas) do
      local note_beat=beat+delta
      row.offsets[#row.offsets+1]={delta=delta,note_beat=note_beat,y_offset=ArrowEffects.GetYOffset(ps,1,note_beat)}
    end
    result.speed_samples[#result.speed_samples+1]=row
  end
  for _,rate in ipairs({1,1.5,2}) do
    sample("MMod",rate,600,0,0)
    sample("XMod",rate,3,0,0)
    sample("CMod",rate,600,0,0)
  end
  sample("MMod",1.5,350,0.4,0.2)
  po:MMod(600)
  po:Wave(0)
  po:WavePeriod(0)
  so:MusicRate(original_rate)
  have_speed=true
  result.complete=true
end
return Def.ActorFrame {
  Name="MultitapNativeProbe",
  InitCommand=function(self)
    observe("song-init")
    local earliest_update,earliest_draw=false,false
    local initial_pose_signature=nil
    local initial_before_updates=0
    local initial_before=ITGMANIA_HARNESS_BEFORE_SCREEN_UPDATE
    ITGMANIA_HARNESS_BEFORE_SCREEN_UPDATE=function(delta)
      if initial_before then initial_before(delta) end
      local player,field=actors()
      if phase==0 and player and field and initial_before_updates<3 then
        observe("initial-before-screen-update")
        initial_before_updates=initial_before_updates+1
        publish()
      end
    end
    local initial_clock=ITGMANIA_HARNESS_GAMEPLAY_CLOCK_INPUTS
    ITGMANIA_HARNESS_GAMEPLAY_CLOCK_INPUTS=function(inputs)
      if initial_clock then initial_clock(inputs) end
      local player,field=actors()
      if player and field and not earliest_update then
        observe("first-observable-after-gameplay-actors")
        earliest_update=true
        publish()
      end
    end
    local initial_draw=ITGMANIA_HARNESS_AFTER_SCREEN_DRAW
    ITGMANIA_HARNESS_AFTER_SCREEN_DRAW=function()
      local player,field=actors()
      if player and field and not earliest_draw then
        observe("first-observable-after-native-screen-draw")
        earliest_draw=true
        publish()
      end
      if phase==0 and player and field then
        local signature=tostring(field:GetZoom())..":"..tostring(field:GetRotationX())
        if signature~=initial_pose_signature then
          observe("initial-after-native-screen-draw-pose-change")
          initial_pose_signature=signature
          publish()
        end
      end
      if initial_draw then initial_draw() end
    end
  end,
  OnCommand=function(self)
    observe("song-on-before-mutation")
    apply_case(1)
    local previous_clock=ITGMANIA_HARNESS_GAMEPLAY_CLOCK_INPUTS
    ITGMANIA_HARNESS_GAMEPLAY_CLOCK_INPUTS=function(inputs)
      if previous_clock then previous_clock(inputs) end
      if phase>update_recorded then
        observe("after-gameplay-actors")
        update_recorded=phase
      end
      if not have_speed and GAMESTATE:GetPlayerState(PLAYER_1):GetSongPosition():GetSongBeatVisible()>=6 then
        speed_samples()
        publish()
      end
    end
    local previous_draw=ITGMANIA_HARNESS_AFTER_SCREEN_DRAW
    ITGMANIA_HARNESS_AFTER_SCREEN_DRAW=function()
      if phase>draw_recorded and phase<=update_recorded then
        observe("after-native-screen-draw")
        draw_recorded=phase
        publish()
        if phase<#cases then apply_case(phase+1) end
      end
      if previous_draw then previous_draw() end
    end
  end
}
reproduction.probe_lua_note: This latest observation-only probe adds early lifecycle hooks. The 240/480 captures used earlier hook variants identified by their retained probe hashes; speed sampling and transform case mutations are identical.
